fields.question: What are your shipping options?
fields.answer: We offer standard shipping (5-7 business days) and express shipping (2-3 business days). Free standard shipping on orders over $100.

fields.question: Do you ship internationally?
fields.answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination.

fields.question: What is your return policy?
fields.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original condition with tags attached.

fields.question: How do I initiate a return?
fields.answer: Log into your account, go to Order History, select the order, and click 'Return Items'. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label via email.

fields.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
fields.answer: Yes, exchanges are free for domestic orders. Simply initiate a return and place a new order for the correct size.

fields.question: What payment methods do you accept?
fields.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay.

fields.question: How do I track my order?
fields.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with tracking information. You can also track your order in your account dashboard.

fields.question: How do I find my size?
fields.answer: Each product page includes a size guide with detailed measurements. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up for a relaxed fit or down for a more fitted look.

fields.question: Are your products sustainable?
fields.answer: Yes, we're committed to sustainability. We use organic and recycled materials where possible, and our packaging is 100% recyclable.

fields.question: How do I reset my password?
fields.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the instructions in the reset email you'll receive.

fields.title: About ÉLAN
fields.subtitle: Where timeless design meets conscious craftsmanship
fields.mission_text: We believe fashion should be timeless, not temporary. Our mission is to create pieces that transcend seasons and trends, designed with care and built to last. Every garment is a statement of quality, crafted from premium materials with meticulous attention to detail.
fields.story_text:
Founded in 2020, ÉLAN was born from a simple belief: that modern fashion could embrace both elegance and sustainability. We started with a single collection of essential pieces, each designed to work seamlessly together and stand the test of time.

Today, we continue that vision—creating clothing that honors both heritage craftsmanship and contemporary design. From our atelier to your wardrobe, every piece tells a story of quality, care, and conscious creation.

fields.title: Quality Craftsmanship
fields.description: Every piece is crafted with premium materials and exceptional attention to detail. We work with skilled artisans who share our commitment to excellence.

fields.title: Timeless Design
fields.description: We create pieces that transcend fleeting trends. Our designs are rooted in classic silhouettes with modern refinements that ensure longevity.

fields.title: Sustainable Practice
fields.description: Committed to responsible fashion, we use organic and recycled materials wherever possible and ensure ethical production practices throughout our supply chain.

fields.title: Conscious Creation
fields.description: We believe in slow fashion—producing thoughtfully, in limited quantities. Each collection is carefully curated to minimize waste and maximize value.
